title: Chin-Up
summary: An underhand pull-up that uses more biceps.

muscles.why: Library rating 1 for lats (main mover): each working set adds 1 of a set to the weekly lats total.
Library rating 0.8 for biceps (main mover): each working set adds 0.8 of a set to the weekly biceps total.
Library rating 0.4 for upper back (helper): each working set adds 0.4 of a set to the weekly upper back total.
Library rating 0.3 for forearms (minor): each working set adds 0.3 of a set to the weekly forearms total.

setup.text: Hang with your palms facing you, about shoulder width apart.
Pull your shoulders down and drive your elbows down to your sides.
Pull until your chin clears the bar.
Lower all the way to a full hang.

form_cues.cue: Pull your chest toward the bar
Avoid kicking or swinging. Keep it a strict pull.

mistakes.text: Doing half reps that never reach a full hang.

lower_risk.text: Warm-up: the app adds two or three ramp-up sets at rising loads before the first working set, unless that load is very light.
The app suggests a heavier load only when the jump is 5% or less; otherwise it adds a rep first.
Default target: 6-10 reps, stopping about 3 reps short of failure (RIR 3). Stop the set when form breaks down.
Use the same controlled range on every rep; lower under control rather than dropping or bouncing.
Pick a variation and range you can train pain-free.
